elements.text: The premises were let for residential purposes.
binding_requirements: The premises evaluated under this element must be the same premises evaluated under the other elements of the claim.

elements.text: The premises are required bona fide by the landlord for occupation as a residence.
binding_requirements: The premises said to be required must be the same premises identified in the residential-letting element.
The landlord referred to here must be the landlord whose qualifying occupation route is evaluated under DRC_BONA_FIDE-E03.

elements.text: A qualifying occupation route exists under the supplied wording: either occupation for the landlord himself or a dependent family member, together with the stated ownership qualification, or occupation for a person for whose benefit the premises are held.
binding_requirements: For the landlord/dependent-family branch, DRC_BONA_FIDE-C03 and DRC_BONA_FIDE-C04 must refer to the same landlord and the same premises.
Within DRC_BONA_FIDE-C03, any dependent family member must be a member of the family of that same landlord.

For the person-for-whose-benefit branch, the person in DRC_BONA_FIDE-C05 and the premises held for that person's benefit must be the same person and premises carried into the accommodation element to the extent the phrase 'such person' applies.
No identity between the landlord and the person for whose benefit the premises are held is assumed.

elements.text: The landlord or such person has no other reasonably suitable residential accommodation.
binding_requirements: The subject phrase is preserved exactly at the statutory level as 'the landlord or such person'.
The supplied excerpt does not independently resolve every antecedent or route-specific consequence of 'such person'; no broader identity binding is imposed.
No additional criteria for determining whether other residential accommodation is 'reasonably suitable' are supplied.
